mapper.select: SELECT e.EMP_ID, e.DEP_ID, d.DEP_NM, e.EMP_NM, e.EMP_LEV, e.REG_DTTM, e.MAX_SEND_CNT, e.PERM_CPN, e.PERM_SYS, e.PERM_STA, e.NOW_SEND_CNT, e.LAST_SEND_DT, e.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, e.EMP_PHONE, e.PERM_PSN, e.PERM_AUT, e.PERM_CPN_AGREE, e.DEL_DTTM, e.ACT_YN, e.LAST_LOGIN_DTTM, e.PASS_UPDATE_DTTM, e.PASS_UPDATE_YN, e.PERM_SND_CANCEL, e.UPDATE_DTTM, e.PERM_NOM, e.PERM_NOM_AGREE, e.PERM_MMS, e.PERM_MMS_AGREE, e.MFA_YN FROM SMS.EMP e LEFT JOIN SMS.DEP d ON e.DEP_ID = d.DEP_ID WHERE e.EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT e.EMP_ID, e.DEP_ID, d.DEP_NM, e.EMP_NM, e.EMP_LEV, e.REG_DTTM, e.MAX_SEND_CNT, e.PERM_CPN, e.PERM_SYS, e.PERM_STA, e.NOW_SEND_CNT, e.LAST_SEND_DT, e.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, e.EMP_PHONE, e.PERM_PSN, e.PERM_AUT, e.PERM_CPN_AGREE, e.DEL_DTTM, e.ACT_YN, e.LAST_LOGIN_DTTM, e.PASS_UPDATE_DTTM, e.PASS_UPDATE_YN, e.PERM_SND_CANCEL, e.UPDATE_DTTM, e.PERM_NOM, e.PERM_NOM_AGREE, e.PERM_MMS, e.PERM_MMS_AGREE, e.MFA_YN FROM SMS.EMP e LEFT JOIN SMS.DEP d ON e.DEP_ID = d.DEP_ID
ORDER BY e.REG_DTTM DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
